title: Monolith - an engine-building web game about tech companies
author: ofcats
selftext:
Hi all, here's a computer game I made with help from AI; it's a mix of Codex (mostly Sol) and Claude Code (mix Sonnet 5/5.5 + Opus 5/5.5) for the Node/TS webapp, and OpenAI gpt-image-2 for the card art.

You run a tech company: finish requirements to earn revenue, raise funding, hire engineers and build out your architecture. Let tech debt pile up and incidents start firing. Let morale slide and your engineers slow down, or quit. Once someone IPOs, a clock starts and the highest valuation wins. Or you can win the AI race outright.

I wanted to try to represent the tech company arc from an engineering perspective as an engine-building game. I was looking for something a little dystopian, tongue-in-cheek, but also complex enough for different strategies. Inspired by Lichess, Wingspan, Slay the Spire, MTG, Twilight Struggle and Balatro.

You can play the tutorial, a bot (it’s tough), pass-and-play, or online with friends or ranked. Login only required for ranked or agent play over MCP. I've been toying around with the idea of turning it into a tabletop game too (Menu > Tabletop for demo).

Free to play at:

[https://monolithgame.app/](https://monolithgame.app/)

Feedback welcome!
